# sdlisten

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/service/proc/sdlisten"
```

Package sdlisten — Unix socket activation \(sd\_listen\_fds\(3\) family\). The service side recovers listening sockets an activator passed via inherited fds 3.. plus the LISTEN\_FDS / LISTEN\_PID / LISTEN\_FDNAMES environment; the activator side \(Prepare\) is the symmetric half, so the protocol is testable end\-to\-end without systemd. Fd inheritance is POSIX, so this builds on every Unix; non\-Unix gets a stub returning UnsupportedPlatform.

<a name="Files"></a>
## func [Files](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/sdlisten/sdlisten_unix.go#L135>)

```go
func Files(unsetEnv bool) (files []*os.File, err error)
```

Files returns the inherited listening sockets \(fd 3..3\+LISTEN\_FDS\) as \*os.File, gated on LISTEN\_PID. When unsetEnv is true the activation env is cleared so a grandchild does not re\-inherit it. An empty/foreign activation set yields nil.

<a name="Listeners"></a>
## func [Listeners](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/sdlisten/sdlisten_unix.go#L169>)

```go
func Listeners(unsetEnv bool) (lns []net.Listener, err error)
```

Listeners returns the inherited stream sockets wrapped as net.Listener. Each underlying \*os.File is closed after net.FileListener dups it.

<a name="Prepare"></a>
## func [Prepare](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/sdlisten/sdlisten_unix.go#L217>)

```go
func Prepare(child *coreproc.Spec, named map[string]net.Listener) error
```

Prepare is the activator side: it appends each listener's socket to child as an inherited fd and sets LISTEN\_FDS / LISTEN\_FDNAMES in child.Env so the spawned process recovers them via Files/Listeners. LISTEN\_PID is intentionally omitted \(a pre\-fork activator cannot know the child pid; Files accepts an absent LISTEN\_PID from a trusted parent\). Sockets are passed in sorted\-name order.

<a name="WithNames"></a>
## func [WithNames](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/sdlisten/sdlisten_unix.go#L195>)

```go
func WithNames(unsetEnv bool) (byName map[string][]*os.File, err error)
```

WithNames returns the inherited sockets grouped by their LISTEN\_FDNAMES name \(duplicate names group multiple fds under one key\).
